program.code:
def control(obs):
    bearing = obs.get('route', {}).get('bearing_deg', 0.0)
    hitch = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    desired = max(-25.0, min(25.0, bearing * 0.85))
    steer = max(-34.0, min(34.0, 1.6 * (hitch - desired)))
    return steer, -0.9
